title: Prompting Time plugin status, format 2
description: What a plugin's `status` action prints when its manifest declares `"status": {"format": 2, ...}`. Prompting Time draws the plugin's agent row in the sidebar's Plugins section and the menu bar from this output, and lists its blockers and the items of its `needs_you` groups in the Needs you inbox, which Command-J steps through. Every blocker and item is reachable in the plugin's page and in Command-K's Work group. An item's `group` must be one of the manifest's `status.groups` ids, and its `actions` must be among the manifest's `status.item_actions`. Prompting Time drops an item or blocker that does not fit this schema, an item whose group the manifest does not declare, and an item past the 50th or with an id already listed; it ignores row actions the manifest does not allow and a blocker action the manifest does not declare, and keeps the rest. The output may hold other top-level fields, such as data the plugin's own page reads; Prompting Time ignores them. The agent, blockers, and items allow only the fields listed here.

agent.description: The plugin's row: a few status words and a dot.

words.description: Such as "Polling every 10 min" or "Idle · last run 2 min ago".

blockers.description: Problems that stop every job, such as a signed-out CLI. Prompting Time lists them first in Needs you and marks the menu bar icon while any is listed.

action.description: One of the manifest's actions that fixes or rechecks the blocker; it runs with no extra arguments.

items.description: Current items plus a bounded tail of finished ones, at most 50; set `truncated` when more exist. Full history belongs in the plugin's page.

id.description: Unique among the items; row actions receive it as `--item <id>`.

detail.description: One line of muted text under the title.

project.description: An absolute path of the project the item belongs to, if any.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 with an offset; items in a group list newest first.

actions.description: The row actions that apply to this item, each among the manifest's `status.item_actions`.

truncated.description: Whether the plugin left items out to stay within 50.

paused.description: Whether the plugin is paused. When true, the agent's row and the menu bar offer the manifest's `resume` action in place of `pause`.

dot.description: The design spec's one color mapping: error red, attention orange, success green, running an uncolored dot, idle no dot.

route.description: Where the plugin's page shows this, such as "/runs/run-74c91b1d".
